input_rule.sampling: 608 independent uniform training-window indices with replacement, identical donors across models/seeds and both group interventions
input_rule.replacement: copy complete7day normalizedFP32 channelgroup from donor, leave other group unchanged
input_rule.original_check: regenerate all78x608 originals under matched CPU runtime and require exact elementwise equality with prior CPU arrays; any mismatch stops study
input_rule.scaling: reuse immutable train-only scaler and native model input transformations

statistics.unit: same noncircular moving date blocks for originals and both interventions; all fixed6seeds retained
metrics: mean6seed RMSE changed minus original, in sigma7 units
mean absolute prediction change across fixed6seeds and dates
statistics.intervals: 95percent marginal percentile intervals, conditional on one fixed donor realization, six fitted trajectories, inherited test period
statistics.selection_or_multiple_testing_decision: none; exploratory descriptive estimates and marginal intervals, no simultaneous family claims

limits: Volume distinguished train/test periods in an earlier adversarial diagnostic; this does not establish that volume is spurious or leaking.
Donor inputs preserve each group seven-day path but can lie off joint OHLC-volume support and violate consistency between overlapping windows.
Effects identify model dependence under the specified donor intervention, not causal economic effects, expected live missing-feature performance, or benefit of retraining without the feature.
One donor realization is fixed before inference; confidence intervals do not include donor-assignment uncertainty.
No model, hyperparameter, scaler, calibrator or deployment choice is selected using these results.
Known inherited test608, not a fresh blind holdout. Original A2/RQ1 and CPU benchmark remain unchanged.
